point: 用同一个策略在 iCub 上同时涌现出基于动量的全身 push-recovery 策略,以及踝、髋、迈步策略,这是相对前作 [12] 的主要贡献。
quote_en: Demonstration of the emergence of robust momentum-based whole-body push-recovery strategies in addition to ankle, hip, and stepping ones;

point: 设计了一组奖励项,引导学习走向稳态平衡并在瞬态中产生 push-recovery 策略。
quote_en: Design of reward components to guide learning towards steady-state balancing, with transient push-recovery strategies;

point: 定义了一个受浮动基座动力学启发的状态空间,在不需要任何期望轨迹先验知识的情况下编码了求解任务的充分信息。
quote_en: Definition of a state space – inspired by floating-base dynamics – encoding sufficient information for solving the task with no prior knowledge about the desired trajectories.

point: 方法是无模型深度强化学习,在仿真中训练通用且鲁棒的人形 push-recovery 策略,并在 iCub 上验证。
quote_en: We apply model-free Deep Reinforcement Learning for training a general and robust humanoid push-recovery policy in a simulation environment. Our method targets high-dimensional whole-body humanoid control and is validated on the iCub humanoid.

point: 奖励项里融入了人形控制的专家知识,使同一个策略快速学到多种跨越全身的鲁棒行为。
quote_en: Reward components incorporating expert knowledge on humanoid control enable fast learning of several robust behaviors by the same policy, spanning the entire body.

point: 采用 PPO 算法,优化带裁剪的目标 LCLIP,使新策略与旧策略保持接近。
quote_en: Among the available PG algorithms, we employ Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO)

point: 环境跑在 Ignition Gazebo 仿真器(gym-ignition 框架)里,物理引擎是 DART,用 iDynTree 算刚体动力学。
quote_en: Its dynamics runs in the Ignition Gazebo simulator embedded into the gym-ignition framework [38], compatible with OpenAI Gym [39]. The enabled physics engine is DART [40].

point: 环境以 25 Hz 收发动作/观测/奖励,物理和底层 PID 以 1000 Hz 运行。
quote_en: The environment receives actions and provides observations and rewards at 25 Hz. The physics and the low-level PIDs run at 1000 Hz.

point: 策略输出 a∈R23,是机器人一大部分关节(腿、躯干、手臂)的参考速度,经积分后送入对应的 PID 位置控制器;手、腕、颈被锁定。
quote_en: the policy generates an action a ∈ R23 composed of the reference velocities for a large subset of the robot joints (controlled joints), which are then integrated and fed to the corresponding PID position controllers. The controlled joints belong to the legs, torso, and arms. Hands, wrists, and neck, which arguably play a minor role in balancing, are locked in their natural positions.

point: 策略以 25 Hz 计算目标关节速度,范围限制在 [-180,180] deg/s;用速度而非位置作动作是为避免连续步之间目标关节位置跳变、PID 跟不上。
quote_en: The policy computes target joint velocities bounded in [−180180] deg/s at 25 Hz.

point: 观测从状态计算得到,定义为 o:=⟨os,os˙,oh,oR,oc,of,oF,ov⟩,O:=R62,不含任何感知信息。
quote_en: the observation, computed from the state x, is defined as the tuple o := os, os˙, oh, oR, oc, of , oF , ov∈O, where O := R62.

point: 奖励是一个加权和 Σ ωi ri,分为正则项、稳态项(只在双支撑 DS 激活)、瞬态项三类;实/向量分量先过 RBF 核归一化以统一量纲。
quote_en: The reward is a weighted sum of terms that can be categorized as regularizers, steady-state, and transient.

point: 全身动量项 rh 最小化机器人质心总动量(线动量与角动量分量之范数和),利用上身躯干和手臂产生的动量做平衡与 push-recovery。
quote_en: This term minimizes the sum of the norms of the linear and angular components of the robot’s total centroidal momentum Gh [15].

point: 若除脚以外任何连杆触地,则该回合以 -10 的终端奖励终止(连杆触地项 rl)。
quote_en: If any link excluding feet is in contact with the ground, the episode terminates with a negative reward of −10 for the terminal state.

point: 训练时用外力做探索:对基座施加固定大小 200 N、持续 200 ms 的 3D 力,方向从均匀球面分布采样,平均每 5 仿真秒施加一次;按 iCub 约 33 kg 算,归一化冲量为 1.21 Ns/Kg。
quote_en: The applied force vector has a fixed magnitude of 200 N and is applied for 200 ms. Considering the weight of the iCub, approximately 33 kg, the normalized impulse sums up to 1.21 Ns/Kg.

point: 域随机化:连杆质量按 N(m0,0.2m0) 采样,脚的库仑摩擦系数 μc 按 U(0.5,3) 采样,送 PID 的位置参考加 U(0,20) ms 的延迟。
quote_en: The masses of the robot’s links are sampled from a normal distribution N (μ = m0, σ = 0.2m0)

point: 策略和值函数各用一个独立神经网络,均为两层全连接(512 和 128 单元)接线性输出层,隐层用 ReLU,两网络不共享层。
quote_en: We represent both the policy and the value function with two different neural networks composed of two fully connected layers, with 512 and 128 units each, followed by a linear output layer. The hidden units use a ReLU activation function. The networks do not share any layer.

point: 分布式训练:32 个并行 worker 各持一份环境副本,收集 10000 条 on-policy transition 后用 SGD 训练,minibatch 512、每批 32 个 epoch,学习率 0.0001;每次试验跑到 20M agent steps 才停,约等于真机 7 天经验。
quote_en: After collecting a batch of 10 000 on-policy transitions, we train the neural networks with stochastic gradient descent. The optimizer uses minibatches containing 512 samples and performs 32 epochs per batch. The learning rate is λ = 0.0001. Each trial is stopped once it reaches 20 M agent steps, roughly equivalent to 7 days of experience on a real robot.

point: PPO 超参:折扣 γ=0.95,裁剪参数 ε=0.3,GAE 参数 λ=1.0,值函数裁剪参数 1000(见表 III)。
quote_en: Discount rate γ

point: 学习曲线在 11 次独立训练上平均奖励一致增长且方差低,回合时长也随训练提升、方差低,越来越频繁接近最大回合长度。
quote_en: Average reward across trials exhibits consistent growth and low variance (Fig. 2, left).

point: 确定性水平面推力测试:训练范围内(0-200 N)的推力均被成功抵抗;策略对所有方向 200-300 N 的样本外力也鲁棒,部分方向可达 400 N。
quote_en: Magnitudes within the training range (0-200 N) are counteracted successfully. Remarkably, the policy is also robust to out-of-sample forces in all directions in (200-300 N), up to 400 N in some directions.

point: 即便用样本外的测试摩擦系数 μc=0.2,策略仍能从训练范围(0-200 N)内的推力中恢复。
quote_en: Moreover, it successfully recovers from pushes in the training range (0-200 N) even with an out-of-sample test friction coefficient μc = 0.2

point: 对基座施加随机球面力(平均每 3s 一次):无论大小,持续 0.1s 的力都能被平衡;平均能扛住 9 次连续的 300 N、0.2s 的施力。
quote_en: For instance, on average it withstands 9 consecutive 300 N 0.2 s applications.

point: 对未见过的施力点泛化:肘部平均能扛 10 次连续 200 N 0.2s 力,基座为 17 次,胸部降到 5 次;离质心越远的连杆越难。
quote_en: For instance, it is on average able to recover from 10 consecutive 200 N 0.2 s forces on the elbow link, as opposed to an average of 17 for the base link. The average number of consecutive counter-balanced forces with the same magnitude and duration decreases to 5 for the chest link.

point: 为更真实地触发恢复行为,评估时改成向已平衡的机器人投掷高速物体(而非训练时的固定力),观察到踝、迈步、动量等多种恢复策略(图4(b))。
quote_en: To make force profiles more realistic, instead of applying constant forces for a fixed interval as during training, we throw high-speed objects towards the balanced robot.

point: RBF 奖励核 K(x,x*)=exp(-γ̃||x-x*||²)∈[0,1] 用来给各奖励分量做归一化,令 γ̃=-ln(ϵ)/xc²,使测量达到目标时核输出 1、距离等于截断值 xc 时输出 ϵ。

point: 作者自述局限:涌现的 push-recovery 策略不如人类自然,策略倾向用小跳代替完整迈步,可能源于底层 PID 的刚度与接触建模困难。
quote_en: The emerged push-recovery strategies are not as natural as human ones. The policy tends to promote small jumps to full steps, probably due to two factors: the stiffness given by the low-level PIDs, and the difficulty of accurate contact modeling.

point: 作者自述局限:无模型算法学习效率很低,一个复杂行为的涌现需要约 7 仿真天的训练;且仅靠状态空间探索找行为需要精心设计奖励函数,代价不小。
quote_en: The learning efficiency of model-free algorithms is pretty low and requires days of simulations for a complex behaviour to emerge. Finally, relying only on state space exploration for finding the expected behaviours requires a carefully designed reward function, that might require a significant effort.
